Senior Technical Business Analyst with 15+ years of experience in Core Banking, Payments, API
Integration, and Agile software delivery. Experienced in both Technical Business Analysis and
Functional Business Analysis, specializing in requirement elicitation, user story creation, API
analysis, workflow modelling, stakeholder management, and end-to-end delivery. Hands-on
experience in REST API analysis, OpenAPI specification review, API governance, SwaggerHub, ,
GitHub integration, API-UI integration, and payment systems including SEPA, BACS, FPS and
CHAPS.. Well-versed in SAFe Agile practices, cross-functional collaboration, and translating
complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

Collaborated with Product Owners and stakeholders during backlog refinement to

Provided production support by analyzing business issues, coordinating with cross-
functional teams, performing root cause analysis, and ensuring timely resolution of
production incidents.
Supported Incident Management, Change Management, and Release Management by
analyzing business issues, coordinating with stakeholders and technical teams, and
ensuring successful implementation and production support.
Analyzed existing business processes, identified improvement opportunities, and
collaborated with stakeholders to implement solutions that enhanced operational
efficiency and business performance.
Provided end-to-end support for User Acceptance Testing (UAT), coordinating with

Supported the delivery of multiple enterprise API integration projects
Business Systems Analyst II- FIS May/18- Aug/22
Conduct brainstorming sessions and functional walkthroughs with Development and QA
teams to ensure shared understanding of business requirements.
Prepare Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM), workflow diagrams, and business process
documentation.
Conduct demonstrations for business stakeholders and Product Owners.
Monitor project scope, identify potential risks, and proactively manage requirement

Collaborate with Product Owners during backlog refinement and sprint planning

Coordinated source code
review and documentation updates through GitHub
Integration to support development and release management.
Raise, track, and coordinate domain-related issues across multiple teams to ensure
timely resolution.
Gathered and documented business requirements for the Launchpad application,
enabling seamless merchant onboarding and end-to-end merchant servicing.
Acted as the primary Business Analyst for production support, analyzing incidents,
documenting functional defects, and coordinating with stakeholders to ensure service
continuity.
Performed
functional analysis and validation of payment processing, exception
handling, and reconciliation scenarios to ensure compliance with business and
regulatory requirements.
Collaborated with technical teams to validate SWIFT MT and ISO 20022 message
structures, payment data mapping, and API integrations to ensure accurate end-to-end
payment processing
Supported requirements analysis, testing, and defect resolution for payment solutions
involving SWIFT MT, ISO 20022, and payment message transformations.
Gathered and analyzed business requirements for BACS, CHAPS,FPS and SEPA
payment
processing
, supporting end-to-end payment workflows and business rule validation.
Senior Software Test Analyst - FIS Nov/16- Apr/18
Lead QA activities by preparing and executing comprehensive test plans and test
strategies.
Design and execute REST API test scenarios using Postman and validate API responses
against Open API Specifications.
Develop and execute SOAP API test cases using SoapUI.
Monitor application behaviour using Splunk dashboards to support defect analysis and
issue resolution.
Work closely with Product Owners, Developers, Business Analysts, and business
stakeholders to deliver high-quality software releases.
Track quality metrics and present testing progress to stakeholders.
Mentor QA team members and contribute to test planning and quality improvement
initiatives.
Worked with business stakeholders to analyse & test payment flows involving BACS,SEPA
and CHAPS payment processing.
Performed API validation and supported API integration testing with frontend
applications to ensure seamless end-to-end functionality.
Performed end-to-end functional testing of the FIS Payment application (PaaS),
collaborating with business and development teams to validate business requirements,
payment workflows, and system functionality.
Possess basic knowledge of API automation testing using SoapUI, including creating test
suites, test cases, assertions, and executing automated API tests.
Worked with SWIFT MT ,STD18, ISO 20022 (MX) payment messages to analyze business
requirements and validate payment flows
Software Test Analyst – III – FIS Jul/13- Oct/16
Execute manual test cases and validate business functionality across multiple releases.
Analyse test results, log defects, verify fixes, and perform regression testing.
Develop detailed Test Plans, Test Strategies, and Test Cases.
Collaborate with technical teams, business users, and management to ensure successful
product delivery.
Conduct sprint review demonstrations and participate in Sprint Retrospectives.
Manage defect lifecycle using Jira.
Executed end-to-end functional testing of the FIS Core Banking application (Profile)
utilizing WebCSR, WebAdmin, and Teller to validate business processes and system
functionality.
Performed end-to-end functional testing of the Corporate Online Banking (COLB)
application by validating account management, payment processing, beneficiary
management, and transaction workflows.
Performed end-to-end functional testing of the Retail Online Banking (ROLB) application
by validating account inquiries, fund transfers, bill payments, and transaction history
functionalities.
Software Test Analyst – II & I – FIS Nov/10- Jun/12
Performed end-to-end functional testing for the FIS Core Banking application (Profile)
using WebCSR, WebAdmin, and Teller to validate business functionality and ensure
application quality.
Create and execute SQL queries to validate business data and test results.
Log, track, and verify defects using JIRA.
Perform peer reviews of test scripts and business documentation to ensure quality
standards.
Participate in Disaster Recovery (DR) testing activities.
Collaborate with Development and Business teams to resolve production issues.

Senior Business Systems Analyst - FIS/Worldpay Sep/22 - Current
Gather business and functional requirements from Product Owners and business stakeholders and translate them into detailed user stories for Agile development. • Conduct requirement workshops and brainstorming sessions with Product Owners, Architects, Technical Leads, and Development teams to define project scope and solution approach. Facilitated Agile Scrum activities such as sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint demos, and retrospectives.

Prepare Functional Requirement Documents (FRD), workflow diagrams, process flows, use cases, and mapping documents.
Collaborate closely with Development, QA, and Product teams to clarify business requirements and resolve functional gaps during implementation.
Create mock-ups and workflow diagrams to improve requirement understanding and reduce implementation ambiguity.
Drive end-to-end delivery of new initiatives while ensuring alignment with business objectives and project timelines.
Review REST API specifications and validate API documentation against RESTful standards and Open API best practices to improve API consistency and quality. Facilitate sprint demos and support stakeholders throughout the Agile development lifecycle.

Worked on API-UI Integration by validating API contracts with frontend applications to ensure seamless end-user functionality.
Coordinated source code review and documentation updates through GitHub Integration to support development and release management.
Partnered with Architects, Product Owners, and Development teams to incorporate REST best practices into OpenAPI (Swagger) specifications.
• Gathered and documented business requirements and translated them into Agile user
stories with well-defined acceptance criteria.
• Contributed to enterprise API standardization initiatives through OpenAPI governance.
